title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to design and implement a transformative agenda on gender equality, non-discrimination and inclusion

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Knowledge and evidence on emerging forms of discrimination facilitated by artificial intelligence and other digital technologies (2) Policy guidance and tools on addressing discrimination and promoting equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on persons with disabilities, people living with HIV, indigenous people and on people facing racial discrimination, in line with the ILO’s proposed reprioritization; and the need to move towards integrated policy and guidance tools rather than group specific approaches. (3) Knowledge on the underlying causes and impacts of gender-based industrial and sectoral occupational segregation, including in relation to equal pay for work of equal value (4) Knowledge and awareness raising on the nexus between climate change, gender equality and inclusion and just transitions, with special attention to the needs of indigenous peoples, including in rural areas (5) Mainstreaming of HIV and AIDS within work relating to occupational safety and health, social protection, access to services, prevention and elimination of violence and harassment and inclusion. Contribution to the Global AIDS Strategy 2021-2026. End Inequalities. End AIDS
